verification_notes.market_size: Two distinct market framings: (1) AI-specific RCM tools $21.49B (Mordor Intelligence) and (2) total RCM software market $40.58B (Research & Markets). The difference reflects scope — Mordor counts only AI-native/AI-powered tools; Research & Markets includes all RCM software. We use the AI-specific figure for growth tracking since this report covers the AI transformation trend.
verification_notes.waystar_q1: Q1 2026 revenue figure ($313.9M, +22% YoY) sourced directly from Fierce Healthcare coverage of Waystar earnings call. This is a publicly traded company (NYSE: WAY) so earnings data is verifiable via SEC filings.
verification_notes.change_healthcare: Attack date (Feb 21, 2024), ransom amount ($20M), and patient records scope (100M) are sourced from CM-Alliance timeline which aggregates public reports and congressional testimony. The '40%+ of US claims' figure is a widely-cited industry estimate; exact market share varied by source (some sources say 'one in every three' US claims processed by Change Healthcare). Marked as [well-sourced estimate] rather than exact audited figure.
verification_notes.market_players_shares: Market share percentages are editorial estimates based on segment data from multiple sources (GlobeNewsWire vendor listing, individual company revenue disclosures, KLAS rankings). Optum and Epic do not break out RCM revenue separately from their broader businesses. These represent estimated relative positioning, not audited share figures.
verification_notes.akasa_acquisition: AKASA acquisition by Waystar in 2025 referenced in multiple industry sources. Specific acquisition price not publicly disclosed; the $1.25B figure cited in the timeline is the Iodine Software acquisition (confirmed by Fierce Healthcare), not AKASA.
verification_notes.growth_5y: The $5.5B (2021) baseline is a backward extrapolation from the 27.1% CAGR (Mordor). No primary source directly states the 2021 figure; it's derived arithmetic. Marked as estimated.
